summary: First-iteration full-stack test of ElectronicHub. Backend pytest suite (32 tests) covering auth, catalog, cart, coupons, wishlist, reviews, checkout (Stripe), orders, admin CRUD, and admin dashboard — all passing. Frontend smoke test verified Home hero + 8 categories + 7 featured products, Catalog page (17 cards, search, add-to-cart increments cart counter to 1), Customer login redirects to '/', Admin login redirects to '/admin' with dashboard rendering stats (Revenue/Orders/Products/Customers), low-stock panel, recent orders, and Dashboard/Products/Orders/Coupons tabs. No console errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 815 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/products/cart/checkout/admin) for maintainability.
compute_cart_totals uses hardcoded INR->USD divisor of 85; move to env/config for easier updates.
cart_add: when a guest supplies no cart_id, response returns a new cart_id — good; but ensure frontend persists it before further operations (verified working via localStorage 'eh_cart_id').
Stripe webhook endpoint is defined on app (not api_router) at /api/webhook/stripe — routing works but consistency with api_router prefix would be cleaner.
admin_update_order does not validate 'status' enum — any string is accepted. Consider adding Pydantic model with allowed values (pending_payment/confirmed/shipped/delivered/cancelled).
get_cart with unauthenticated + no cart_id queries {'cart_id': ''} which is unusual; low risk but returns empty list.
No pagination metadata on /api/orders and /api/admin/orders (returns full list up to 500). Fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 17 products, 2 coupons (WELCOME10, MAKER100), and both users on startup. During tests, 1 TEST_ product was created & deleted (admin CRUD), 1 signup user created, 1 review created for a product, 1 pending_payment order + Stripe session created, 1 test coupon created (TEST_ prefix). No cleanup fixtures used — test data left behind is minimal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py runs in <5s via pytest-xdist. All 32 tests pass. Reuse it as regression suite. Frontend flows validated at UI level (Home, Catalog, Login, Cart, Admin). Stripe payment completion NOT tested end-to-end (only session creation + status polling).
